# ASIC cost model calibration (sky130_fd_sc_hd, tt_025C_1v80)

Generated by `python -m hw_dse.models.cost_asic` from `eval/data/asic_synthesis.csv`. Every *measured* number: yosys 0.33 + OpenSTA 3.1.0; liberty sky130_fd_sc_hd__tt_025C_1v80.lib (OpenROAD-flow-scripts 5a76f84ed, sha256 ec0e1067a35c...) minus lpflow_*/probe_* cells; 10 ns clock; post-synthesis STA, wire-load model. Every *estimate*: `sky130hd-tt_025C_1v80-yosys0.33-opensta-v1`.

Points: 57 generated designs, all four families. Errors are (estimate / measured − 1).
